This release contains the native GPUI version of Refiner.

- **macOS:** choose the Apple Silicon (`arm64`) or Intel (`x64`) DMG, then drag Refiner to Applications. ZIP bundles are also provided.
- **Windows:** extract the ZIP for your architecture and run `Refiner.exe`. These are portable builds, with no Tauri or WebView runtime.
- **SHA256SUMS:** checksums for all six downloads.

macOS apps are ad-hoc signed, without Apple notarization. Windows executables are unsigned. On macOS, grant Refiner Accessibility access to capture selections.
